scope: 3.3.5. Cross-scenario adaptability to an MBR treating industrial wastewater

matched: Additional validation on pilot MBR treating petrochemical and pharmaceutical wastewater
Disturbance-driven biomass dynamics and complex TMP perturbations in industrial MBR
Distinct wastewater properties with higher TCOD, SCOD, MLSS, MLVSS
Conserved EPSc range (43.6 ± 20.2 mg/L vs 32.3–43.5 mg/L), EPSp order of magnitude, and SMPc overlap
Zero-shot performance R2 = 0.46 improved to R2 = 0.89 at FT = 40% with MAE -68.6% and RMSE -54.7%
SHAP attribution pattern: EPSc highest (~0.238), SMPp second highest (~0.150)
Mechanistic basis: elevated SMPp (27.6 ± 17.4 mg/L vs 10.8–13.8 mg/L) and disturbance-driven soluble protein release during biomass loss and cell decay
Preservation of transferable EPSc information combined with target-specific recalibration toward plant-specific signals
